import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    k = int(next(it))
    a.sort()
    ans = 0
    left = 0
    for right in range(n):
        while a[right] - a[left] > k:
            left += 1
        ans = max(ans, right - left + 1)
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
